newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan wheat tender still seen - U.S. attache.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan wheat tender still seen - U.S. attache.

text.p: Pakistan is likely to tender for at least 100,000 tonnes of U.S. or Australian wheat this month, the U.S. agriculture attache in Islamabad said on Monday.
"We're still under the impression they will have at least 100,000 to buy," he said, but acknowledged that the Ministry of Food and Agriculture had put out conflicting signals.
The attache said the tender, which had originally been expected on March 16, could now be issued on March 23.
The U.S. agent for Pakistan and other U.S. exporters said on Friday they believed the tender was not going to happen.
